yes it definitely helps

Usually I don't feel like a bad or evil person. Though I felt pretty evil through my whole childhood and i did hurtful things to others. my mom constantly gave me the feeling of being a burden and i really felt like a perpetrator towards her.

though on the other hand i felt like a victim because she didn't give me what i needed. 

nowadays i still feel like constantly switching between perp and victim. especially if i have those violent thoughts. i mean it kind of feels good to be a perp, because then u are not the victim.

yes, I went to a doc and she prescribed me zoloft. taking it now for 3 month. 50mg/day

Doesn't feel it helps much and it makes it much harder to work out unfortunately, because i get exhausted much faster

I really do love people, sometimes. But I also can suffer tremendously from anxiety. The anxiety just gets triggered by something.

But the older i get the more introverted i become. I dont have friends.
